thread_analysis.thread_summary: Nihon Bousai Gijutsu Center (Japan Disaster Prevention Technology Center, Kenji Fujii) completed Bluetooth SIG registration for a fire-extinguisher-shaped AR goggle controller. The thread covers the tail end of the registration process (Submission confirmation, certification completion explanation, outline drawing substitution for the Compliance Folder) plus a separate, detailed follow-up conversation about SIG account management roles — multi-person administration, Primary Contact vs Listing Owner, shared email address usage, and the self-service Listing Owner transfer feature introduced July 1, 2024.
all_questions_found: Can a single registration have multiple Listing Owner/Contacts, or how can we transfer ownership without losing access?
What can our newly created individual member accounts do, and what's the Primary Contact vs Listing Owner difference?
Can multiple employees be administrators via a shared/group email address?
Does 'The submission has been approved' on screen mean registration is officially complete, and where is the certificate?
Can we substitute a reference DevKit's outline drawing for our own dispersed-component product's outline drawing?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: SIG account hierarchy: Primary Contact (company membership registrant) vs Listing Owner (per-registration executor) — each with different transfer mechanisms and different tolerance for shared/group email addresses. Since July 1, 2024, self-service Listing Owner transfer via 'Manage Submitted Products' > 'Change Contact' replaced the old manual SIG-staff-driven process. Certificates were discontinued roughly a decade ago; current proof of certification is the green approval banner plus public Publish Date visibility. Compliance Folder outline drawings can be substituted with a reasonable proxy (e.g., reference DevKit drawing) when the actual product's physical layout makes a literal drawing impractical.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Account role hierarchy determines transfer mechanisms and shared-address tolerance; system-confirmed Submission approval is authoritative even without a separate manual approval email; document substitutions for Compliance Folder materials are acceptable with customer agreement when the literal requirement is impractical to satisfy.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Misunderstanding account role hierarchy could lead to using a shared address for Primary Contact (undermining legal delegation), and a customer unaware of certificate discontinuation might mistakenly doubt their registration's completeness.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None identified — Allion answered all account-management nuances accurately and proactively proposed a practical Compliance Folder documentation workaround.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For customers asking about account succession/multi-administrator planning, clearly separate the rules for Primary Contact versus Listing Owner roles, and reference the post-July-2024 self-service Change Contact feature as the modern solution. For Compliance Folder document gaps caused by unusual product designs, proactively propose practical substitutions rather than insisting on a literal but impractical document.
